title: Add API skeleton

context.summary: Create the Fastify API skeleton with config loading, health/readiness, auth placeholder, project route stubs, error handling and structured logging.
context.background: TASK-4 defined the canonical database schema. TASK-5 establishes the API process shape before adding persistence-backed endpoints.

in: Add config loading helpers for the existing MINDORY_* environment contract.
Create a Fastify app factory and server entrypoint in apps/api.
Add an auth middleware placeholder that attaches an authorization context without enforcing permissions yet.
Add project endpoint route stubs for POST /v1/projects, GET /v1/projects and GET /v1/projects/:id.
Add structured error and not-found responses.
Add API skeleton validation to repository checks.
Update API, configuration, architecture and README documentation.
out: Implement database repositories or persistence-backed project endpoints.
Implement token validation or permission enforcement.
Change Docker Compose app services away from explicit placeholders.
Install dependencies if pnpm is unavailable in the local environment.

acceptance_criteria: apps/api contains a Fastify app factory and server entrypoint.
The API skeleton loads config from MINDORY_* environment variables.
GET /health and GET /ready routes are defined.
An auth placeholder attaches an authorization context without storing raw bearer tokens.
Project routes exist for POST /v1/projects, GET /v1/projects and GET /v1/projects/:id.
Project route stubs return structured 501 responses until repositories are implemented.
Error and not-found handlers return structured JSON with request_id.
Fastify structured logging is configured from config.
Repository checks include API skeleton validation.
Documentation describes the API skeleton and current placeholder limits.
No database repository, token validation, worker, MCP, CLI or Hermes behavior is implemented.

commands: ls apps/api/src/app.ts apps/api/src/server.ts apps/api/src/routes/health.ts apps/api/src/routes/projects.ts packages/config/src/index.ts
manual_checks: Confirm project endpoints are route stubs and do not pretend to persist data.
Confirm no raw bearer token is logged or stored in the placeholder authorization context.

risks: Local pnpm is unavailable in the current environment, so Fastify and TypeScript execution must wait until dependencies are installed.
Docker Compose still uses TASK-3 placeholders until a later task adds runnable images or installed dependencies.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch can be merged into master without unrelated changes.
